validity.researcher_notes: Duplicate check per the orchestrator's watchlist (P7318 vs P7319, both 'Musturad-Banha Oil Products Pipeline'). Traced the sheet's own current_ref (youm7.com, 2024-10-10) — verified live and confirmed to contain '52 كم' plus 'مسطرد حتى بنها' together — and found it is a near-verbatim republish of Petroleum Pipelines Company (PPC)'s FY2023-2024 general-assembly report also carried by almasdar.com/146948 (same wire content; both count as ONE origin, not two independent sources, per the corroboration rule). That release lists, among PPC's 'efficiency-raising' (رفع الكفاءة) projects: 'انشاء خط من مسطرد حتى بنها بطول 52 كم لرفع معدلات تدفيع المنتجات البترولية من منطقة الدلتا الى مسطرد ومنها الى السويس' (construction of a NEW 52 km Musturad-Banha line to raise product-pumping rates from the Delta region to Musturad and on to Suez) — a distinct capacity-addition project, separate in the same document from an entirely different Musturad-area item ('خط مازوت مسطرد - محطة كهرباء شبرا الخيمة', a mazut replacement/renewal line to a power station) that a different, genuinely independent article (almasryalyoum.com/news/details/3294097, 2024-10-29, verified live) also touches on. That almasryalyoum piece covers a community EIA-consultation session for 'مشروع انشاء خط منتجات مسطرد - بنها' (construction project for the Musturad-Banha products line) — the same 52 km new-build project, corroborating its EXISTENCE independently of the PPC wire story (different outlet, different date, different specific event) — so EXISTENCE is high-tier (2 independent sources). But that same article's closing background note states plainly: 'يشار الى ان خط منتجات مسطرد بنها يبلغ قطره 16 بوصة بطول 45 كم ويعد احد الروافد الهامة من الخطوط خلال الفترة الحالية' (it is noted that the Musturad-Banha products line is 16in / 45km and is one of the important current tributary lines) — i.e. describing the OLD, ALREADY-OPERATING 45 km/16in line (= P7318) in the present tense as background context, not the new 52 km project under EIA review. So the two GEM rows map cleanly onto two real, separately-sourced physical projects on the same corridor (old operating line + new capacity-addition build), consistent with the 'same name, different length, real parallel lines' pattern — not a double-count.

validity.researcher_notes: Two lesser caveats found while confirming this row. (1) Diameter: the '16 in' figure is not stated anywhere in the PPC wire release (youm7/almasdar) for the NEW 52 km project — the only place '16 in' appears in either harvested source is almasryalyoum's background sentence describing the OLD, separate 45 km line (P7318, see the paired validity entry). GEM's Diameter [ref] on this row cites the youm7 URL, which does not actually state a diameter for the 52 km build; the 16in value is therefore an unconfirmed carry-over assumption (same pipe size as the existing corridor), plausible but not independently verified for this specific new segment — downgrade to medium/low until a source states the new line's diameter directly. (2) Direction: PPC's own description of the project's purpose is '...لرفع معدلات تدفيع المنتجات البترولية من منطقة الدلتا الى مسطرد ومنها الى السويس' — i.e. product flow is described as moving FROM the Delta region (where Banha sits) TO Musturad, and onward to Suez. That phrasing is consistent with Banha as the origin and Musturad as a midpoint/destination, the reverse of the sheet's StartLocation=Musturad / EndPrefecture=Banha. This may simply reflect naming-convention ordering (both GEM rows and the Arabic sources consistently call it 'مسطرد-بنها'/'Musturad-Banha' regardless of flow direction) rather than a real error, so I am not recommending a swap outright — but it is worth a second look if better documentation appears. Everything else on the row checks out: PipelineType=transmission and Fuel='Oil products (only)' match the PPC network description (product/multi-product pipeline, not crude, not single-fuel mazut); Status=construction is reasonable (the 52 km line is listed as 'عرض' — presented/planned among efficiency-raising projects — and is the subject of an active EIA community-consultation session as of Oct 2024) though no source uses the literal word 'construction'; Owner1=Egyptian General Petroleum Corp at 100% is the standard GEM attribution for PPC-network product lines and is not contradicted by anything found. Capacity, FuelSource (specific product), StartYear1 and ProposalYear remain genuinely blank in the source material — left unfilled rather than guessed.

summary: P7319 confirmed real (2 independent sources) and not a duplicate of P7318 (which is a separate, already-operating 45km/16in line the current ref's background text actually describes); flagged as caveats: Diameter=16in and Length=52km are single-wire-sourced with diameter unconfirmed for this specific new build, and PPC's flow-direction wording hints Start/End may be reversed — no fields changed, Capacity/FuelSource/dates left unfilled for lack of sourcing.
